title: HeartbeatMessage
description: Both directions, on a timer of period heartbeat_ms (20 ms) from welcome until the connection closes (SPEC.md section 6). The runtime's watchdog listens to the motion client's heartbeats.

n.description: Heartbeat number on this connection and in this direction: 0 for the first, then +1 for each, so a receiver can count missing heartbeats.

last_seq.description: From the motion client: the last sample it has processed. From the runtime: the last sample it has sent. Absent before the first sample.

epoch.description: From the motion client: its current epoch.
